snippet.title: FULL METAL COFFIN - GamePlay Trailer
snippet.description:
FULL METAL COFFIN is a 3D co-op submarine simulator. Crew your vessel with up to 4 players. Load the torpedoes, dodge incoming fire, and eliminate the enemy. #indiegame #navalgame #simulator 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3529670/FULL_METAL_COFFIN/
